questions.prompt_zh: 中華人民共和國國旗的紅色象徵甚麼？
questions.prompt_en: What does the red of the national flag stand for?

questions.prompt_en: What do the five yellow stars stand for?
options_en: The great unity of the Chinese people

questions.prompt_zh: 最大的那顆黃星代表甚麼？

options_zh: 中國共產黨領導下的革命人民大團結
options_en: The four classes stand against each other
The great unity of the revolutionary people under the leadership of the Communist Party of China

stations.lead_zh: 點區旗上發光的部分，回答它代表甚麼。
stations.lead_en: Tap each glowing part of the regional flag and say what it stands for.

questions.prompt_en: Red and white are used together on the regional flag. What does that stand for?
options_en: An extension of the national flag

stations.lead_zh: 把旗拖到旗桿上，再決定這句話對不對。
stations.lead_en: Drag each flag onto its pole, then say whether the statement is true.

questions.prompt_zh: 列隊持旗行進時，國旗走在最前。
questions.prompt_en: When flags are carried in a parade, the national flag goes first.

questions.prompt_zh: 兩旗平列懸掛時，左方是國旗。
questions.prompt_en: When the two flags hang side by side, the national flag is on the left.
questions.why_zh: 以背向牆壁的人的左右為準，國旗在右方。
questions.why_en: Take left and right from someone facing away from the wall: the national flag is on the right.

questions.prompt_zh: 國旗和區旗可以同掛在一支旗桿上。
questions.prompt_en: The national flag and the regional flag may fly from the same pole.

questions.prompt_zh: 兩旗並列升起時，國旗先升。
questions.prompt_en: When the two flags are raised together, the national flag goes up first.

questions.prompt_zh: 兩旗並列降下時，國旗先降。
questions.prompt_en: When the two flags are lowered together, the national flag comes down first.
questions.why_en: The national flag is lowered last.

questions.prompt_zh: 升旗和降旗都要奏國歌。
